title: FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit: Courtesy Waiver and Retention Allowances
content:
FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit tiers differ in how many courtesy fee waivers a line can receive and in whether an annual fee can be waived for a borrower who keeps the line open.

| Tier | Courtesy waivers per line in any rolling 12 months | Waiver request window (calendar days after the fee's assessment date) | Annual-fee retention waiver offered |
|---|---|---|---|
| FlexLine Starter | 1 | 60 | Yes |
| FlexLine Standard | 1 | 60 | Yes |
| FlexLine Plus | 1 | 60 | Yes |
| FlexLine Preferred | 1 | 60 | No |
| FlexLine Premier | 2 | 60 | No |
| FlexLine Elite | 2 | 60 | No |

Definitions carried with the allowances:

- *Courtesy waivers*: Courtesy waivers of a late or returned-payment fee per line in any rolling 12 months (integer).
- *Request window*: Calendar days after a fee's assessment date within which a courtesy waiver may be requested.
- *Retention waiver*: Whether an annual fee charged in the last 30 days is waived when the borrower asks to close over it and agrees to keep the line open.

## Allowance questions

**How many courtesy waivers can a FlexLine Premier line receive in a rolling 12 months?** Two; a FlexLine Starter, FlexLine Standard, FlexLine Plus or FlexLine Preferred line can receive one.

**Is the retention waiver available on a FlexLine Elite line?** No. It is offered on FlexLine Starter, FlexLine Standard and FlexLine Plus only.

**Does the request window differ by tier?** No; it is 60 calendar days on all six tiers.
